select_devices.title: Manage devices
select_devices.description: Select which Yarbo devices to monitor and how Home Assistant keeps them awake.

data_description.keep_awake_mode: Always: HA renews the wake-up every 4 minutes so the device never sleeps. Only while charging: wake-up is renewed only while the device is charging on the dock. Never: HA never wakes the device automatically; data updates only while the device is awake on its own.

pick_preset.title: Pick a starting preset
pick_preset.description: All presets are starting points — you'll customize the plan and any other settings on the next screen before saving.

add.title: Add schedule
add.description: Pick a plan and the conditions under which it should run automatically. Schedules are evaluated once per minute; a run fires only when every condition passes. Expand the sections below to configure quiet hours, conditions, and notifications.

data_description.plan: Which Yarbo plan this schedule fires.
data_description.interval_days: Soonest the next run can fire after the last successful completion. Decimals OK (0.5 = 12h). 0 = no cooldown (rely on other gates like snow accumulation).

data.use_sun_for_sleep: Also block when the sun is below the threshold

data_description.sleep_start: Local time. Cross-midnight ranges (22:00 → 06:00) work as expected.
data_description.sleep_end: Local time. Equal to start = always awake.
data_description.use_sun_for_sleep: When on, the sun-elevation threshold (in Advanced) also gates the run.

data.weather_hold_states: Weather states that block a run

data_description.weather_entity: HA weather entity. Hold runs when its state is in the list below.
data_description.weather_hold_states: Conditions that block the run. Add custom values for non-standard providers.
data_description.battery_min_pct: Hold the run if battery is below this. The mower will recharge then re-evaluate next tick.
data_description.presence_entities: Hold while any selected person/device_tracker/zone is 'home'. Useful for skipping when guests are over.
data_description.required_head_type: Hold the run unless this attachment is currently installed. Substring match, case-insensitive (e.g. 'mower' matches both Mower and Mower Pro).
data_description.min_snow_accumulation: Hold the run unless the weather entity's forecast over the lookahead window has at least this much snow. Same units as the entity reports. 0 = no gate.
data_description.rain_rate_entity: Numeric sensor for the rain gate. Use the Yarbo onboard 'Rain sensor' (enable it in entity settings — it's off by default) for the mower's own reading, or any external rate sensor (e.g. sensor.openweathermap_rain). Complements the state-based weather entity above.
data_description.rain_rate_max: Hold the run while the rain sensor reads at or above this value. Units depend on the sensor: external rate sensors are typically in/h or mm/h; the Yarbo onboard sensor is a 0–1000+ ADC reading where higher = wetter. 0 = gate disabled.

data.post_hold_run: Run once after weather hold clears (cleanup)

data_description.pre_run_notify_target: HA notify services called when this schedule starts a run. Multi-select; pick zero or more (e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone, notify.email). Custom services can be typed in.
data_description.complete_notify_target: HA notify services called when this schedule's run ends — successful, stopped, or errored. Multi-select.
data_description.post_hold_run: When weather transitions from holding → clear, fire one extra cleanup run. Bypasses cooldown + weather + snow gates for that one fire.

data_description.sun_elevation_threshold: Negative = below horizon. −6° = civil twilight; useful for 'after dusk'. Only applies when 'Use sun for sleep' is enabled.
data_description.snow_forecast_hours: How far ahead to sum forecast precipitation for the snow gate. Only applies when 'Minimum forecast snow' is > 0.
data_description.pre_run_notify_minutes: Reserved for a future delayed-pre-run mode. Currently ignored — the start notification fires when the run begins.

add.title: Add zone rule
add.description: Auto-enable selected no-go zones based on a trigger condition, releasing them after a rolling grace period.

data.name: Rule name
data.duration_hours: Duration after trigger ends to keep enabled

data_description.name: Display label for this rule.
data_description.zones: No-go zones that get enabled while the rule is engaged. Pick zones from a single device.
data_description.trigger_type: What activates this rule. Precipitation = accumulated rain/snow rate. Presence = while any selected entity is 'home'.
data_description.duration_hours: Rolling timer. Each tick the trigger is still active, the timer resets to this value. When it elapses, zones are released.

data.dry_reset_hours: Reset accumulator after this much dry time

data_description.rate_entity: A sensor reporting current rate (e.g. sensor.openweathermap_rain). Required when trigger type = Precipitation.
data_description.event_threshold: Same units as the rate sensor. Engages once accumulated rate × time exceeds this.
data_description.dry_reset_hours: When not engaged, zero out the accumulator after this much dry time so old rain doesn't accumulate forever.

data_description.presence_entities: Person, device_tracker, or zone entities. Required when trigger type = Presence. Useful to lock vision-avoidance zones around parked cars while you're home.
